files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
## Changed
- Migrated to Vue 3 and use nextcloud/vue 9
- Adjust to file actions breaking changes in NC 33
- Bump min supported NC version to 33
- Modernized settings

lines: CHANGELOG.md has the heading for 2.0.0, but nothing under it.
The App Store would show only the sections of its pre-releases. Where nothing changed since the last of them, the section says so: No notable changes since <pre-release>.
